title: Hi Corey Here - Sing Pal (Backing Vocals)
lyrics:
[Intro – Base Layer Only (vocal instruments + didgeridoo + percussion, long build)]
(deep didgeridoo drone… drrr-oom-drrr-oom… wub-wub supersaw rise… rolling vocal bass… tss-tss-tss… arpeggio sparkle… vocal pads swell… supersaw shimmer… didgeridoo growl building slowly under everything… crisp vocal claps snapping… rolling bass thunder growing… long sustained didgeridoo drone pulsing like a heartbeat… vocal percussion starting to lock in… doom-tss-doom-doom-tss patterns fading in softly at first then stronger… full vocal instrument chaos rising… didgeridoo overtones swirling… supersaw leads stabbing through the mix… wide stereo movement left to right… warm low end thump… bright high end shimmer… tension building for a full minute of pure vocal layer energy before any real singing appears… reporters flashing energy in the vocal stabs… corey stacking power in the rolling bass… sly funky electro-house groove sneaking in under the didgeridoo drone… camera shutter FX popping as crisp vocal claps… lights flashing everywhere in the supersaw shimmer…)
[Vocal Percussion Intro – Pure Acapella Base Layer Only (extended and driving)]

[Verse 1 – Base Layer Only (full vocal instruments + didgeridoo dominant, long hypnotic section)]
(deep didgeridoo pulsing strong… supersaw shimmer dancing around the drone… rolling bass thunder hitting hard… arpeggio sparkle flying left to right… vocal pads swelling wide… crisp claps snapping on every off-beat… didgeridoo growls and overtones swirling underneath… vocal percussion groove locked tight… supersaw leads stabbing through… warm low end thump… bright high end shimmer… extended groove with no singing for maximum base layer power… reporters flashing left and right in the vocal stabs… corey stacking every answer in the rolling bass thunder… sly funky electro-house sliding in under the didgeridoo…)
[Short Male Real Singer Hook – minimal & sparse (very short, almost whispered over the huge base layer)]
Reporters flashing… Corey stacking… Sing Pal! I sing it back…
[Verse 2 – Base Layer Only (extended didgeridoo + doom-tss groove, even longer hypnotic section)]
(doom-tss groove locked harder… arpeggio sparkle exploding… vocal pads swell bigger… didgeridoo drone pulsing deeper… supersaw leads cutting through… rolling bass thunder rumbling… crisp vocal claps and snares snapping… long circular breathing didgeridoo tones… vocal percussion driving the entire groove… full vocal instrument chaos with wide stereo movement… tension rising again… pure base layer energy for a long stretch… no comments… just the vocal layer flex…)
[Short Female Real Singer Hook – minimal & sparse (very short, joyful but brief over the massive base layer)]
Mucho gusto… no comments… Song Pal style…
[Pre-Chorus – Both Real Singers very short + Base Layer dominant (quick layered harmony, then straight back to base layer)]
Year 1 wish… tus deseos se cumplan… I sing it back…
[Chorus – Duet Real Singers short & punchy over full base layer (still very sparse, powerful but quick)]
Sing Pal! I sing it back!
No comments… just Song Pal attack!
Hi Corey here… let the wishes rain!
[Vocal Percussion Break – Pure Acapella Base Layer Only (longest section – extended festival breakdown)]
